This topic is part of the IB SL IBDP Design Technology specification.

Classic Design appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Classic Design in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The IB SL board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Classic Design.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
